I fixed it in `packages/injected/src/roleUtils.ts`. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested.

In `getTextAlternativeInternal`, the embedded-control branch that adds a control's value to the name only checked `role === 'textbox'`. An `<input type=search>` has the role `searchbox`, so it fell through and added nothing. The check is now `role === 'textbox' || role === 'searchbox'`. A search input inside a `<label>` or an `aria-labelledby` target now adds its value, the same as a text input.

I didn't add a test.
